senses.gloss: नदि- + ईश नदि- + ईश, m. the ocean, Pañc. ii. d. 27.

नद् नद् (probably a form of नर्द्), i. 1, Par. (also Ātm. MBh. 2, 1925), To sound, to roar, MBh. 3, 2855. Frequently with the acc. of a noun expressing sound, e. g. शब्दम्, To utter a sound, MBh. 3, 15655.
 --Caus. नादय, To cause to resound, to fill with noise, Rām. 1, 28, 5. Anomal. ptcple. of the pres. Ātm. नादयान, MBh. 6, 2269. नादित, n. Sound, 1, 7650. Frequent.
 1. नानद्, To roar, Chr. 290, 8 = Rigv. i. 64, 8; MBh. 7, 882.
 2. नानद्य, To make a great noise, 7, 887.
 --With the prep. अनु अनु, To sound against (with acc.), Rām. 2, 111, 53 Gorr. (to rise to).
 --Caus. To cause to resound, to fill with noise, MBh. 5, 5169.
 --With व्यनु वि-अनु, Caus. To fill with noise, Bhag. 1, 19.
 --With अभि अभि,
 1. To sound against, Bhāg. P. 1, 2, 2 (to answer).
 2. To roar, Hariv. 11042 (p. 791).
 --Caus. To fill with noise, 13859. अभिनादित, Re-echoed, 4582.
 --With आ आ, Caus. To fill with noise, MBh. 3, 789.
 --With उद् उद्,
 1. To roar, MBh. 7, 6814.
 2. To bray, Pañc. 248, 17.
 --With प्रोद् प्र-उद्, To roar, Hariv. 6754.
 --With समुद् सम्-उद्, To roar, Hariv. 13167.
 --With उप उप, Caus. To fill with noise, Rām. 2, 28, 10.
 --With नि नि.
 1. To resound, Pañc. 158, 5.
 2. To sing, Rām. 2, 65, 2.
 3. To cry, Ragh. 5, 75.
 --Caus. To fill with noise, MBh. 1, 119. निनादित, n. Sound, Rām. 1, 73, 36.
 --With परि परि, To cry aloud, MBh. 6, 3256.
 --With प्र प्र, णद् णद्, To begin to sound, to roar, MBh. 2, 1925; 3, 2859. प्रणदित, [] Buzzing, Śiś. 9, 71.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, Caus. To fill with noise, Rām. 5, 12, 45.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To cry, Rām. 5, 1, 87.
 --Caus. To fill with a cry, Rām. 4, 29, 15.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To answer with a cry, or with cries, Rām. 3, 24, 30; (with acc.) Rājat. 4, 285; MBh. 6, 4518.
 --Caus.
 1. To fill with cries, Hariv. 4179.
 2. To cry aloud, MBh. 3, 14057.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To resound, Rām. 4, 9, 44.
 3. To cry, 3, 30, 6.
 3. To roar, MBh. 1, 6002.
 4. To cry round about somebody (acc.), 11, 599.
 5. To fill with cries, Hariv. 8097.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to sound, or to cry, Bhāg. P. 8, 8, 13; Ghaṭ. 10.
 2. To fill with noise, MBh. 1, 1187.
 3. To sound aloud, Rām. 6, 11, 23.
 --With अनुवि अनु-वि, Caus. To fill completely with noise, Rām. 2, 103, 48.
 --With अभिवि अभि-वि, To cry aloud, Rām. 6, 37, 37.
 --With सम् सम्, To roar, MBh. 7, 8127.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to resound, MBh. 1, 2896.
 2. To cry aloud, MBh. 7, 8386.

नद नद् + अ,
 I. m. A river, MBh. 1, 8730. A male river, Man. 6, 90.
 II. f. दी, A river, 3, 9; a female river, 6, 90.
 --Comp.

नाद नाद, i. e. नद् + अ, m.
 1. Roaring, Rām. 4, 29, 12.
 2. Sound, cry, MBh. 4, 1885; 14, 2694.
 3. A semicircle representing the nasal sound, Bhāg. P. 7, 15, 53.
 --Comp.
नदिका नदिका, i. e. नदि + क, f. See क-नदिका, s. v. कु-.

नदीज नदी-ज,
 I. Born near a [] river, epithet of horses, Rām. 1, 6, 24 Gorr.
 II. m.
 1. Epithet of Bhīṣma, the son of the Gaṅgā, MBh. 4, 1294.
 2. Antimony, Suśr. 2, 340, 16.

नदीष्ण नदीष्ण, i. e. नदी-स्न (vb. स्ना), adj. Versed in, Ragh. 16, 75.
 --Comp.

नादिन् नादिन्, i. e. नद् or नाद + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Sounding, sounding aloud, Hariv. 8069; MBh. 2, 987.
 II. m. a proper name, Hariv. 12941.

नादेय नादेय, i. e. नदी + एय,
 I. adj.
 1. Coming from a river, Suśr. 1, 170, 11.
 2. Aquatic, Rām. 4, 39, 12.
 II. n. A sort of salt, Suśr. 2, 326, 9.
नद-नदी- + पति नद-नदी- + पति, m. a name of the Sindhu.
नद- + राज नद- + राज, the king of the rivers, i. e. the Sindhu, Śiś. 9, 30.
